description_good_justification: https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire#readme : the opening paragraphs state that Columnwire sends tables from Spring Boot to React as Apache Arrow instead of JSON, on the same endpoints.
interact_justification: How to obtain it (Maven Central, npm), give feedback (GitHub issues) and contribute is on https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire#readme and https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md : tests for new behaviour, contract test for wire-format changes, benchmark numbers for speed claims, CI green on JDK 17/21/25 and Node.
documentation_basics_justification: https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire#quick-start covers installing and using the Spring Boot starter and the React package; https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/blob/main/js/packages/columnwire/README.md documents the JS API.
documentation_interface_justification: https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire#how-it-behaves documents content negotiation, Vary, 406 behaviour, batching and the Java to Arrow to JS type mapping; https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire#configuration lists the settings.
sites_https_justification: The repository, GitHub Pages demo, npm and Maven Central are all served only over HTTPS.
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are public, searchable and addressable by URL: https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/issues
english_justification: All documentation and discussion are in English.
maintained_justification: Actively maintained: 0.1.0 released 2026-11-02, changes continue on main. https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/commits/main
repo_track_justification: Git on GitHub records every change, its author and its date.
repo_interim_justification: Work between releases is committed to main: https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/commits/main
repo_distributed_justification: Git, a distributed version control system.
version_unique_justification: Each release has a unique version and tag: https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/releases
release_notes_justification: https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md and the GitHub Release notes built from it: https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/releases/tag/v0.1.0
release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known vulnerabilities have been fixed in any release; none have been reported.
report_process_justification: Bug and feature issue forms: https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/issues/new/choose , described in https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
report_responses_justification: No bug reports have been submitted yet; the maintainer responds to every report (CONTRIBUTING.md).
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement requests have been submitted yet; the maintainer responds to every request.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: GitHub private vulnerability reporting is enabled: https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/security/advisories/new , documented in https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability reports have been received yet; SECURITY.md commits to acknowledgement within 3 days and assessment within 7.
build_justification: Maven (mvn verify) and npm (npm run build), documented in https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
build_floss_tools_justification: Maven, OpenJDK, Node.js and TypeScript are FLOSS.
test_justification: JUnit 5 suites for columnwire-core and the Spring Boot starter (against a real Tomcat), and Vitest suites for the npm package, including a Java to JavaScript contract test and fast-check property tests: https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/tree/main/js/packages/columnwire/test
test_invocation_justification: mvn verify and cd js && npm test, documented in https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
test_most_justification: Every module and public API has tests: https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/tree/main/columnwire-core/src/test , https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/tree/main/columnwire-spring-boot-starter/src/test , https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/tree/main/js/packages/columnwire/test
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions run all tests on every push and pull request on JDK 17, 21 and 25 and Node 22: https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/actions/workflows/ci.yml
test_policy_justification: https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md : new behaviour needs tests in the module it touches, and wire-format changes need a contract test case.
tests_are_added_justification: Recent changes add tests alongside the code, e.g. the property tests that came with the NaN sort fix: https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/commit/df0fd62
tests_documented_added_justification: The pull request template asks for tests: https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/blob/main/.github/pull_request_template.md
warnings_justification: TypeScript strict mode with noUncheckedIndexedAccess; CodeQL security-and-quality analysis of Java and TypeScript on every change.
warnings_fixed_justification: Warnings are fixed; CodeQL reports no open findings: https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/security/code-scanning
warnings_strict_justification: TypeScript strict mode and CodeQL's security-and-quality suite.
know_secure_design_justification: The maintainer applies least privilege (read-only workflow tokens, job-scoped writes, pinned actions), fail-safe defaults (Arrow only on explicit request, 406 otherwise, a startup check that refuses to run misconfigured) and economy of mechanism.
know_common_errors_justification: The maintainer knows the common vulnerability classes for Java and web code (OWASP Top 10, CWE Top 25) and runs CodeQL's security queries on every change.
crypto_published_justification: Columnwire implements no cryptography. Release artifacts are signed with GPG outside the software itself.

vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: There are no known vulnerabilities (OpenSSF Scorecard Vulnerabilities check: 0; Dependabot alerts enabled).
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerabilities have been reported.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: Credentials live only in GitHub Actions secrets; GitHub secret scanning and push protection are enabled on the repository.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (security-and-quality) analyses Java and TypeScript on every push, pull request and weekly: https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/actions/workflows/codeql.yml
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL's security queries for Java and TypeScript.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: No open medium or higher CodeQL findings: https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/security/code-scanning
static_analysis_often_justification: On every push and pull request, and weekly.
dynamic_analysis_justification: fast-check property-based tests run in CI on every change; they found a real comparator bug with NaN, fixed in https://github.com/DHARANEESH-SRINIVASAN/columnwire/commit/df0fd62
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Java and TypeScript are memory-safe languages.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Every property and test case runs with assertions (AssertJ, Vitest expect).
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: The NaN comparator bug found by property testing was fixed in the same change.
